verdict.rationale: Mirrors surfaces insights from your agent's own trace data: it shows which mistakes repeat across production runs, previews matches against stored conversations, and compares outcomes against holdout groups. The docs never say these insights are AI-generated, though. Suggestions are explicitly written by you or your coding agent rather than generated by the product, and routing runs without model inference. Missing for 10: evidence that insights are AI-generated, in-product AI-suggested corrections or fixes, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
